label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee/feast for the mayor at the great hall on day 1 at eighteen, preparing 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns and arranging the mayor's attendance under the description of a lighting and table-layout inspection. Innkeeper baked and delivered bread; freight coordinated supplies, bartered and delivered bread; builder installed lanterns, paid in planks for bread and arranged the escort. Baker knowingly helped by supplying barter bread and promising to keep the surprise private. No evidence secretary or neighbour knew the celebration's purpose; secretary scheduled the stated inspection openly. Mayor was told about the inspection, not the jubilee; the record ends before any reveal.
